outcome: Magnitude of moderate to severe post-operative pain after cesarean section
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean deliveries at Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Hawassa, Ethiopia between February 1 and September 30, 2021
finding: The magnitude of moderate to severe post-operative pain after cesarean section was 89.8%, and was significantly associated with duration of the procedure, type of anesthesia used, and type of analgesics administered.
